name: Mugen Tenshi Exusia
source:
Tatsuya is told by Ouka that she loves him. However, he loves Yuki, so he refuses it. One night, a huge mark appears on the sky and it never disappears. No one knows what it is. In this confusion, Tatsuya happens to know his and Yuki's identity. Tatsuya is a son of the God and Yuki is an angel, his supervisor. The mark on the sky is a warning sign that someone breaks into the heaven. Tatsuya and Yuki start working together to check it and they find out that they love each other along the way and finally sleep together.... And they find out the ringleader is the Devil at last.... Will they be able to destroy the ringleader and save the world?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106151507/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005600]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
十河王香向牧之濑达也告白，告诉他自己深爱着他。然而，达也爱的人是天羽梦妃，因此拒绝了王香。

一天夜里，天空中出现了一个巨大的印记，此后再也没有消失。没有人知道那究竟是什么。混乱之中，达也偶然得知了自己与梦妃的真实身份：达也是神之子，梦妃则是负责监护他的天使。天空中的印记是一道警告，意味着有人闯入了天界。

达也与梦妃开始联手调查此事。相处过程中，两人发现彼此相爱，最终发生了关系……而在最后，他们又查明幕后主使竟是魔王……他们能否消灭元凶、拯救世界？
